about_the_game:
🩷 Waifu Pogo Club

Every fall tests your patience, not your pants.
Waifu Pogo Club is a rage-inducing, sweetly sadistic pogo platformer starring an anime girl who really shouldn’t have trusted gravity this much.

Climb ridiculous obstacle courses, scream, laugh, moan (a little), and fall straight back to where you started.
Then do it again - because you can’t stop.

💥 Features:

  • Waifu Physics: Feel every bounce, wobble, and glorious failure.

  • Soul-breaking parkour: A single slip can erase 10 minutes — and it somehow feels amazing.

  • Single & Multiplayer: Compete, cooperate, or sabotage your friends in chaotic online climbs.

  • Customization: Unlock cute outfits, goofy pogo sticks, and effects that make suffering look adorable.

Whether you’re here for the challenge, the chaos, or… other reasons, Waifu Pogo Club is ready to make you laugh, rage, and question your life choices - one jump at a time.
